observations: 3 photos show a blue industrial gear reducer/gearbox unit with cast body and a yellow output shaft/coupling area.
Unit has a large circular end housing and a base mounting plate with bolt holes.
No visible nameplate, model number, gear ratio, input/output speed, or HP rating in the photos.
Brand watermark text on photos reads 'FABROS INDUSTRIAL' (appears to be a posting watermark, not a readable model).

claims.claim: Gear reducer 15 to 20hp cast bodies types
claims.evidence: Photos show a cast-body gear reducer, but no readable nameplate/specs confirming 15–20hp or the exact type.

risks.risk: HP rating / duty rating may not be 15–20hp (could be lower/higher), affecting safe use and price.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the nameplate/spec label showing HP rating, input speed (RPM), output speed (RPM), gear ratio, and model/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic industrial gear reducer with unknown rating (worst case for buyer: treat as not confirmed for 15–20hp).

risks.risk: Wrong input/output configuration (shaft size, mounting pattern, flange type) may not match the buyer’s motor or application.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up measurement/shot of: input shaft diameter & keyway, output shaft diameter & keyway, bolt-hole pattern on the base, and any coupling/flange dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mismatched/unknown fit (worst case: buyer may need adaptation).

risks.risk: Condition/working status unknown (could be seized, noisy, leaking, or worn bearings/gears).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of it running under load (or at least free-spin test) plus a photo of oil level/any leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: assume needs service/repair).

risks.risk: Gear ratio/type unknown (single-stage vs multi-stage, reduction ratio) which determines value.
risks.proof: Nameplate photo showing gear ratio and type, or a spec sheet from the manufacturer.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown ratio (worst case: lowest-value generic reducer).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the nameplate/spec label (HP rating, input/output RPM, gear ratio, model/serial).
Close-up measurements: input shaft diameter/keyway, output shaft diameter/keyway, and base mounting bolt-hole pattern.
Video showing it running (or at minimum: smooth free-spin) and photos of any oil/leak points.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is an industrial cast-body gear reducer, but the key details that determine the correct match and price (HP rating confirmation, gear ratio/type, and working condition) are not readable or verifiable from the provided images.
